day_local: Talaadada Usbuuca 31-aad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Waxaan kugu ammaani doonaa, Rabbiyow, shirka dadkaaga.
homily:
Bal ka fikir sawirka marti-qaad weyn oo la diyaariyey. Miisaska waa la dhigay, cuntadii ugu fiicnayd waa la kariyey, guriguna wuu iftiimayaa. Laakiin mid ka mid ah martidii ayaa leh, 'Waxaan iibsaday beer, waa inaan tagaa si aan u soo eego.' Mid kale ayaa leh, 'Waxaan iibsaday dibi, waa inaan qiimeeyaa.' Mid kale oo cusub oo guursadayna wuxuu leeyahay, 'Ma iman karo.' Waxay dhammaantood u muuqdaan kuwo mashquul ah, kuwo leh hawlo muhiim ah, balse waxay seegayaan waxa ugu muhiimsan: marti-qaadkii nolosha. Waxay seegayaan fursadda ay ku wadaagi lahaayeen farxadda sayidka guriga.

Waxaan maanta ka fikireynaa Benjamin Vo. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil aan marnaba seegin 'marti-qaadkan' nolosha. Waxaad ogtihiin sida uu u ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda, koodhka, iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines'—shirkaddaas yar ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin Ben, in kasta oo uu caqli badnaa, marnaba kuma mashquulin 'beero' ama 'dibi' uu is-yiraahdo waa inaan qiimeeyaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbigiisu uu had iyo jeer u furnaa dadka kale. Wuxuu ahaa wiil si dabiici ah u ogaa in qiimihiisu uusan ku xirnayn guulaha uu gaaray, ee uu ku xirnaa jacaylka uu bixinayay.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idin sheego runta: Ilaah wuu idin arkaa. Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Ciise uu 'is-madhiyeen, isagoo qaadanaya qaabka addoon.' Waa sawirka is-hoosaysiinta. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil is-hoosaysiin badan. Xusuusnow markii uu dhowr sano ka hor, isagoo da' yar, uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabayo inuu bixiyo lacagtiisa sanduuqa ku jirta si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo waa calaamad muujinaysa jacayl aan xad lahayn. Taasi waa jacaylka uu maanta ku dhex leeyahay jannada. Jacaylkaas ayaa ah kan maanta idin daryeelaya.

Ben wuxuu hadda la joogaa dadka quduuska ah. Wuxuu la joogaa kuwa dhibaatada soo maray ee hadda nabad helay. Wuxuu la joogaa Saint Carlo Acutis, oo isaguna ahaa wiil dhalinyaro ah oo nolosha u arkaayay indho jacayl leh. Waxay labadooduba hadda u duceeyaan qoysaskooda, waxay u duceeyaan dhakhaatiirta, waxay u duceeyaan carruurta kale ee la ildaran xanuunka, si aan qoys kale u marin jidkan xanuunka badan. Ben waa 'con chim'—shimbirtaas yare ee hadda si xor ah ugu duulaysa hawada jannada, isagoon lahayn wax culeys ah ama xanuun ah.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, xusuuso in Ben uu weli ku jiro wadnahaaga. Adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha ku raaxaysataan, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Sida gacantii uu Ben u fidiyay qoyskiisa, jacaylka uu kuu hayo wuxuu sii wadi doonaa inuu ku dhex koro nolol maalmeedkaaga, isagoo ku siinaya xoog iyo rajo. Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in geedka noloshaada uu weli Ilaah daryeelayo, isagoo ku daraya jacayl maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciisow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin si sacramental ah, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan ku duubayaa naftayda adiga, ha ii oggolaan inaan waligay kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabad weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Waxaan u barriinaa Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii ka horreeyey ee dhintay, inay hadda ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
Waxaan u barriinaa dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan, in Ilaah uu qalbigooda u dejiyo oo uu siiyo rajo xoog leh.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Yeela idinka dhextiinna dabeecaddii ku jirtay Ciise Masiix, kaas oo, in kastoo uu ahaa qaabka Ilaah, aan u arkin sinnaanta Ilaah wax la qabsado. Hase yeeshee, wuu is-madhiyeen, isagoo qaadanaya qaabka addoon, isagoo u imanaya qaab bini'aadam; oo markii la helay isagoo u eg bini'aadam, wuu is-hoosaysiiyey, isagoo noqday mid addeecsan ilaa dhimashada, xataa dhimashada iskutallaabta. Sababtaas awgeed, Ilaah aad buu u sarraysiiyey oo wuxuu siiyey magaca ka sarreeya magac kasta, si magaca Ciise ay jilib kasta u foorarsato, kuwa jannada iyo kuwa dhulka iyo kuwa dhulka hoostiisa, oo carrab kastana uu u qirto in Ciise Masiix uu yahay Rabbiga, ammaanta Ilaaha Aabbaha ah.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Waxaan kugu ammaani doonaa, Rabbiyow, shirka dadkaaga. Waxaan fulin doonaa nidarradayda kuwa isaga ka cabsada hortooda. Kuwa hooseeya ayaa dhergi doona; kuwa Rabbiga doondoonaa way ammaani doonaan: 'Qalbigiinna ha ku faraxsanaado weligiin!' R. Waxaan kugu ammaani doonaa, Rabbiyow, shirka dadkaaga. Dhammaan dunida darafyadeeda ayaa xusuusan doona oo u jeesan doona Rabbiga; Qoysaska quruumaha oo dhan ayaa hortiisa u foorarsan doona. R. Waxaan kugu ammaani doonaa, Rabbiyow, shirka dadkaaga. Waayo Rabbiga ayaa leh xukunka, isagaa u taliya quruumaha. Isaga oo keliya ayay u foorarsan doonaan dhammaan kuwa dhulka ku seexda. R. Waxaan kugu ammaani doonaa, Rabbiyow, shirka dadkaaga. Naftaydu isaga ayay u noolaan doontaa; farcankaygu way u adeegi doonaan. Jiilka soo socda ha loo sheego Rabbiga, si ay ugu wacdiyaan dad weli dhalan caddaaladda uu muujiyey. R. Waxaan kugu ammaani doonaa, Rabbiyow, shirka dadkaaga.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Mid ka mid ah dadkii Ciise la fadhiyey miiska ayaa ku yiri, 'Barakaysan yahay kii wax ka cuna Boqortooyada Ilaah.' Wuxuu ugu jawaabay, 'Nin ayaa sameeyey marti-qaad weyn oo uu u yeeray dad badan. Markii la gaaray waqtigii cuntada, wuxuu u diray addoonkiisii inuu ku yiraahdo kuwa la casuumay, 'Kaalaya, wax walba hadda waa diyaar.' Laakiin mid mid ayay dhammaantood bilaabeen inay cudurdaarasho sameeyaan. Kii ugu horreeyey wuxuu ku yiri, 'Waxaan iibsaday beer, waa inaan tagaa si aan u soo eego; waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad ii cudurdaarto.' Mid kalena wuxuu yiri, 'Waxaan iibsaday shan lammaane oo dibi ah, waxaana ku sii socdaa inaan qiimeeyo; waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad ii cudurdaarto.' Mid kalena wuxuu yiri, 'Waxaan hadda guursaday naag, sidaas darteed ma iman karo.' Addoonkii wuxuu tegey oo u warramay sayidkiisii. Markaas ayuu sayidkii gurigu cadhooday oo wuxuu amray addoonkiisii, 'U bax si dhakhso ah waddooyinka iyo jidadka magaalada, oo halkan keen kuwa saboolka ah, kuwa curyaanka ah, kuwa indhaha la' iyo kuwa lugaha la'. Addoonkii wuxuu yiri, 'Sayidow, amarradaadii waa la fuliyey, oo weli meel baa bannaan.' Sayidkii wuxuu markaas amray addoonkii, 'U bax waddooyinka waaweyn iyo jidadka, oo dadka ku qasab inay yimaadaan si gurigaygu u buuxsamo. Waayo, waxaan idin leeyahay, midna kuwaas la casuumay ma dhadhamin doono cuntadayda.'

day: Tuesday of the Thirty-first Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
